text.body:
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ |
tatra khalu bhagavān bhikṣūn āmantrayate sma |
bhidyanta āyuḥsaṃskārā jīvitaṃ coparudhyate |
paṇḍitāḥ parihīyante vīryam ārabhadhvaṃ dṛḍham || [1]
% ārabhyatāṃ?
ye durlabhāṃ labhitvā pravrajyāṃ jinaśāsane |
mokṣārthinā na pūjyante vañcitās te suduḥkhitāḥ || [2]
varaṃ te jīvitaṃ tyaktaṃ varaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃgatam |
na tvayā khaṇḍitaṃ śīlam evaṃ buddhaiś ca varṇitam || [3]
jīvitaṃ tyajamānāya ekajanma vinaśyati |
śīlaṃ tu khaṇḍamānāya janmakoṭiṃ vinaśyati || [4]
% °koṭir, surely
jīvitaṃ tyajamānāya viyogo jñātibhir bhavet |
śīlaṃ tu rakṣamāṇāya bhaved buddhaiḥ samāgamaḥ || [5]
śīlam ābharaṇaṃ cāgraṃ śīlaṃ gandhānulepanam |
prāmodyakāraṇaṃ śīlaṃ śīlaṃ śītodakaṃ jalam || [6]
śīlam eva praśamnāti śīlaṃ lokasya cottamam |
yatra ghorā viṣā nāgāḥ śīlavān na vihanyate || [7]
śīlena rājate bhikṣuḥ śīlena labhate yaśaḥ |
śīlena labhate saukhyaṃ śīlaṃ svargaparāyaṇam || [8]
yathā netravihīnasya nāsti rūpanidarśanam |
evaṃ śīlavihīnasya nāsti satyanidarśanam || [9]
yathā caraṇahīnasya gamanaṃ nopalabhyate |
evaṃ śīlavihīnasya nirvāṇaṃ nopalabhyate || [10]
yathā bhadraghaṭaṃ sāraṃ sarvaratnānām ākaram |
evaṃ surakṣitaṃ śīlaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ākaram || [11]
yathā bhadraghaṭaṃ bhagnaṃ sadratnaṃ parihīyate |
evaṃ te khaṇḍitaṃ śīlaṃ saddharmaḥ parihīyate || [12]
pūrvaṃ śīlaṃ vināśayitvā paścān nirvāṇaṃ kāṅkṣasi |
karṇanāsādiṃ chittveha ādarśaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || [13]
bahu śrūyati śrotreṇa bahu paśyati cakṣuṣā |
ye śrutvā pratipadyante narās te svargagāminaḥ || [14]
na hi śrotreṇa vaikalyaṃ prabhūtaṃ labhate śrutam |
ye śrutvā pratipādyante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || [15]
kutaḥ strīṣu viśvāsaḥ kuto rājakule priyaḥ |
kutaḥ pheṇopame sāraṃ kuto bhogeṣu nityatā || [16]
nāsti strīṣu viśvāso nāsti rājakule priyaḥ |
nāsti pheṇopame sāraṃ nāsti bhogeṣu nityatā || [17]
yathā nadī tathā bhogo yathā nāvā tathā gṛham |
yathā puṣpaṃ tathā rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ pheṇasaṃnibham || [18]
idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te ca bhikṣavo bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti |
śīlasaṃyuktanāmasūtraṃ navamaṃ samāptam |
